eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 单二进制 · 信创就绪

headline.zh:
一条命令探完盒子
直接拿到可粘贴的启动行
headline.en:
Probe the box in one command
Get a ready-to-paste launch line

sub.zh: 不再逐卡逐模型手调参数。探测显卡、内存、磁盘，按本机硬件合成最优本地大模型启动配置。
sub.en: Stop hand-tuning per card, per model. Probe your GPU, RAM and disk, then synthesize the optimal launch config for on-device LLMs.

body.zh: 每换一张卡、每换一个模型，过去都要刷文档、跑试错、手改启动行。现在一条命令探完盒子，直接合成调好的参数。
body.en: Every new card or model used to mean digging through docs, running trials and hand-editing the launch line. Now one command probes the box and emits tuned arguments.

chips: › GPU · CPU · RAM · NVMe 一次探完

body.zh: 信创盒子上的本地推理，公开调参文档几乎为零。工具读盒子自带的显卡管理命令，把国产卡的后端识别出来，直接给可用启动行。
body.en: On-prem inference on 信创 boxes has near-zero public tuning docs. The tool reads the box's own GPU management commands, maps the domestic-card backend and emits a working launch line.

chips: › 昇腾 / 摩尔线程 vendor CLI

body.zh: 本地编程助手常常继承调参负担——拿到一条按本机调好的启动行，直接粘进终端回车就行，不用再替它试错。
body.en: Local coding agents often inherit the tuning burden. Hand them a launch line already tuned for this box — paste it into the terminal and press enter.

body.zh: 信创盒上可能没有完整开发环境。下载一个二进制就能跑，不引入第二个常驻进程，只在探测阶段借用盒子已有的工具。
body.en: 信创 boxes may lack a full dev toolchain. Download one binary and run it — no second daemon, it only borrows the tools the box already has during probe.

headline.zh: 盒子探完，启动行就在剪贴板
headline.en: Box probed, launch line on your clipboard

sub.zh: 一条命令，从硬件到可用启动行。
sub.en: One command, from hardware to a working launch line.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 信创本地推理
tag.en: MIT open source · on-prem 信创 inference
